newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aluminum shipments fall in May from April.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aluminum shipments fall in May from April.

text.p: U.S. primary aluminum industry shipments in May, including exports, totaled 1.902 billion lbs, down 2.0 percent from April, but ahead of 1.891 billion in May last year, the Aluminum Association reported.
U.S. exports of aluminum ingot and mill products were reported at 271 million lbs in May, unchanged from the previous year.
Imports in May totaled 629 million lbs, up 15.1 percent from May 1996.
In January through May industry shipments totaled 9.293 billion lbs, compared with 8.725 billion in the same period last year.
In June the Association's order index fell 1.27 points to 92.04, from 93.31 points in May, and 77.55 points in June 1996.
